request: In this top-down arena game, an enemy that hits the player is thrown through the player and lands behind them, instead of being knocked back the way it came. A hit should knock the enemy KNOCKBACK meters from the player, on the side it came from. Fix it.

seed.find:
position[0] = player[0] - ux * KNOCKBACK;
            position[2] = player[2] - uz * KNOCKBACK;
seed.replace:
position[0] = player[0] + ux * KNOCKBACK;
            position[2] = player[2] + uz * KNOCKBACK;

reference.find:
position[0] = player[0] + ux * KNOCKBACK;
            position[2] = player[2] + uz * KNOCKBACK;
reference.replace:
position[0] = player[0] - ux * KNOCKBACK;
            position[2] = player[2] - uz * KNOCKBACK;
